59114-my-southern-home-or-the-south-and-.title: The South and Its People.
59114-my-southern-home-or-the-south-and-.creator: Wm. Wells Brown, M.D.
59114-my-southern-home-or-the-south-and-.description: A book by Wm. Wells Brown, M.D.. ts of recent visits to the South, where the incidents were jotted down at the time of their occurrence, or as they fell from the lips of the narrators, and in their own unadorned dialect. Poplar Farm and its occupants. Southern Characteristics. Coon-Hunting and its results. Sunny side of Slave life on the Plantation. The Religious Teaching at Poplar Farm. A Model Southern Preacher. Religious Influence among the Southerners of the olden time. A Southern country Doctor.

67630-kak-the-copper-eskimo.title: The Copper Eskimo
67630-kak-the-copper-eskimo.creator: Vilhjalmur Stefansson
67630-kak-the-copper-eskimo.description: A book by Vilhjalmur Stefansson. n Victoria Island in Canada. He belonged to the Copper Eskimos. This name does not refer in any way to their complexions as “red Indians,” but is given because the people make all their knives and implements out of copper.

arxiv-1409-4942.title: LONG-RANGE BEAM–BEAM EFFECTS IN THE LHC
arxiv-1409-4942.creator: W. Herr, X. Buffat, R. Calaga, R. Giachino, G. Papotti, T. Pieloni, D. Kaltchev, TRIUMF, Vancouver, Canada
arxiv-1409-4942.description: Abstract We report on the experience with long-range beam–beam effects in the LHC, in dedicated studies as well as the experience from operation. Where possible, we compare the observations with the expectations. 1 LAYOUT FOR BEAM–BEAM INTERACTIONS The layout of experimental regions in the LHC is shown in Fig. 1 .

arxiv-2111-12540.title: Quantum-State-Sensitive Detection of Alkali Dimers on Helium Nanodroplets by Laser-Induced Coulomb Explosion
arxiv-2111-12540.creator: Henrik H. Kristensen, Lorenz Kranabetter, Constant A. Schouder, Christoph Stapper, Jacqueline Arlt, Marcel Mudrich, Henrik Stapelfeldt
arxiv-2111-12540.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Henrik H. Kristensen, Lorenz Kranabetter, Constant A. Schouder, Christoph Stapper, Jacqueline Arlt, Marcel Mudrich, Henrik Stapelfeldt. Rubidium dimers residing on the surface of He nanodroplets are doubly ionized by an intense fs laser pulse leading to fragmentation into a pair of Rb + \text{Rb}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}^{\vphantom{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}\hphantom{\text{}}\text{+}} ions.

arxiv-2205-11754.title: Reheating after relaxation of large cosmological constant Preprint: YITP-22-51, IPMU22-0029, RIKEN-iTHEMS-Report-22
arxiv-2205-11754.creator: Paul Martens, Shinji Mukohyama, Ryo Namba
arxiv-2205-11754.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Paul Martens, Shinji Mukohyama, Ryo Namba. We present a cosmological model of an early-time scenario that incorporates a relaxation process of the would-be large vacuum energy, followed by a reheating era connecting to the standard hot big bang universe. Avoiding fine-tuning the cosmological constant is achieved by the dynamics of a scalar field whose kinetic term is modulated by an inverse power of spacetime curvature Mukohyama:2003nw ; Mukohyama:2003ac .

arxiv-2212-04248.title: Talking Head Generation with Probabilistic Audio-to-Visual Diffusion Priors
arxiv-2212-04248.creator: Zhentao Yu, Zixin Yin, Deyu Zhou, Duomin Wang, Finn Wong, Baoyuan Wang
arxiv-2212-04248.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce a simple and novel framework for one-shot audio-driven talking head generation. Unlike prior works that require additional driving sources for controlled synthesis in a deterministic manner, we instead probabilistically sample all the holistic lip-irrelevant facial motions (i.e. pose, expression, blink, gaze, etc.

arxiv-2212-13819.title: Don’t do it: Safer Reinforcement Learning With Rule-based Guidance
arxiv-2212-13819.creator: Ekaterina Nikonova
arxiv-2212-13819.description: Abstract During training, reinforcement learning systems interact with the world without considering the safety of their actions. When deployed into the real world, such systems can be dangerous and cause harm to their surroundings. Often, dangerous situations can be mitigated by defining a set of rules that the system should not violate under any conditions.

arxiv-2303-02300.title: Quantum Gates Between Mesoscopic Spin Ensembles
arxiv-2303-02300.creator: Mohamad Niknam, Robert N. Schwartz, Louis-S. Bouchard
arxiv-2303-02300.description: Abstract Quantum algorithmics with single spins poses serious technological challenges such as precision fabrication, rapid decoherence, atomic-scale addressing and readout. To circumvent atomic-scale challenges, we examine the case of fully polarized mesoscopic spin ensembles (spin-coherent states) whose total angular momenta states map to qudit submanifolds.

arxiv-2405-10892.title: Neuroscheduling for Remote Estimation
arxiv-2405-10892.creator: Marcos M. Vasconcelos, Yifei Zhang
arxiv-2405-10892.description: Abstract Many modern distributed systems consist of devices that generate more data than what can be transmitted via a communication link in near real time with high-fidelity. We consider the scheduling problem in which a device has access to multiple data sources, but at any moment, only one of them is revealed in real-time to a remote receiver.

arxiv-2502-14865.title: Time Travel: A Comprehensive Benchmark to Evaluate LMMs on Historical and Cultural Artifacts
arxiv-2502-14865.creator: Sara Ghaboura, Ketan More, Ritesh Thawkar, Wafa Alghallabi, Omkar Thawakar, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Hisham Cholakkal, Salman Khan, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI, Linköping University, Australian National University, Aalto University
arxiv-2502-14865.description: Abstract Understanding historical and cultural artifacts demands human expertise and advanced computational techniques, yet the process remains complex and time-intensive. While large multimodal models offer promising support, their evaluation and improvement require a standardized benchmark. To address this, we introduce TimeTravel , a benchmark of 10,250 expert-verified samples spanning 266 distinct cultures across 10 major historical regions.

arxiv-2509-00768.title: Aligning Reasoning LLMs for Materials Discovery with Physics-aware Rejection Sampling
arxiv-2509-00768.creator: Lee Hyun, Sohee Yoon, Jinwoo Park, Sue In Chae, Seongeon Park, Jooyeon Ahn, Yebin Jung, Youjung Chung, Hogeun Chang, Sujin Park, Myeonginn Kang, Jina Kim, Ho-Gyeong Kim, Myeonghun Jeong, [1.7em] Materials AI Lab (AI Center), Samsung Electronics
arxiv-2509-00768.description: Abstract AI-driven materials discovery that couples automated experimentation with algorithmic decision-making requires process aware recipe to property predictors that are accurate, calibrated, and physically admissible. We approach this as a reasoning problem with large reasoning models (LRMs). To instill reasoning capability into language models, we curate reasoning traces from a teacher model to train a student model.

arxiv-2602-02546.title: D 2 Quant: Accurate Low-bit Post-Training Weight Quantization for LLMs
arxiv-2602-02546.creator: Xianglong Yan, Chengzhu Bao, Zhiteng Li, Tianao Zhang, Shaoqiu Zhang, Ruobing Xie, Xingwu Sun, Yulun Zhang †
arxiv-2602-02546.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) deliver strong performance, but their high compute and memory costs make deployment difficult in resource-constrained scenarios. Weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ) is appealing, as it reduces memory usage and enables practical speedup without low-bit operators or specialized hardware.

pmc-10560776.title: Dissecting the efficacy of the use of acupuncture and Chinese herbal medicine for the treatment of premature ovarian insufficiency (POI): A systematic review and metaanalysis
pmc-10560776.creator: Hui-fang Li, Jin-xia Zhang, Wen-jun Chen
pmc-10560776.description: Premature ovarian insufficiency is a multi-factor gynecological disease that has become a major global health problem. In recent years, several trials have explored the treatment of premature ovarian insufficiency using Chinese herbal medicine and acupuncture, but the efficacy and safety of this combination remains controversial.

pmc-10638268.title: Subtyping of COVID-19 samples based on cell-cell interaction in single cell transcriptomes
pmc-10638268.creator: Kyeonghun Jeong, Yooeun Kim, Jaemin Jeon, Kwangsoo Kim
pmc-10638268.description: In single-cell transcriptome analysis, numerous biomarkers related to COVID-19 severity, including cell subtypes, genes, and pathways, have been identified. Nevertheless, most studies have focused on severity groups based on clinical features, neglecting immunological heterogeneity within the same severity level. In this study, we employed sample-level clustering using cell-cell interaction scores to investigate patient heterogeneity and uncover novel subtypes.

pmc-10655746.title: Peripheral Blood Inflammatory Cytokine Factors Expressions are Associated with Response to Acupuncture Therapy in Postpartum Depression Patients
pmc-10655746.creator: Yu-Qin Xu, YanHua Gou, Jin-Jun Yuan, Yan-Xian Zhu, Xiao-Ming Ma, Chen Chen, Xing-Xian Huang, Zhuo-Xin Yang, Yu-Mei Zhou
pmc-10655746.description: BackgroundIncreasing evidences demonstrate that immune dysregulation can result in depression, and it is reported that persistent inflammatory response is related to the unresponsiveness of antidepressant treatment.PurposeThis study aimed to explore the reason why some responded but some not responded to acupuncture in treating postpartum depression (PPD), and whether it related to the levels of inflammatory cytokines.

pmc-11738837.title: Case Study of Traumatised Sub-Postmasters
pmc-11738837.creator: Paul Foster
pmc-11738837.description: AimsThe scandal of sub-postmasters wrongly accused by the post office of offences relating to the faulty IT Horizon system is of ongoing media prominence.Since May 2021 I have undertaken personal injury medico legal assessments at the request of a solicitor representing those falsely accused and convicted of offences by the post office.

pmc-12764127.title: Validation of a quality-of-life measure for older people using urgent and emergency care
pmc-12764127.creator: Kiri Lay, Julie Ratcliffe, Rachel Milte, Diana Khanna, Craig Whitehead, Jyoti Khadka
pmc-12764127.description: BackgroundOlder people (aged 65 years and over) frequently present to urgent or emergency care settings, often with multiple health and social care needs. Despite this, their quality-of-life (QOL) is rarely assessed in a systematic or meaningful way. Capturing QOL in these settings is essential for delivering person-centred care for guiding improvements in service planning and delivery.

pmc-13066705.title: Recurrent Radiation-Induced Angiosarcoma of the Breast Without Distant Metastasis: A Case Report
pmc-13066705.creator: Ivan Bivolarski, Martin Dimitrov
pmc-13066705.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Radiation-induced sarcomas represent a rare but aggressive complication following breast cancer treatment, often associated with significant biological heterogeneity and limited therapeutic options. Their clinical course is frequently characterized by high recurrence rates and limited responsiveness to conventional therapies.We report a case of a 76-year-old female with a history of left-sided breast cancer treated in 2017, who subsequently developed a high-grade radiation-induced soft tissue sarcoma of the chest wall. The patient underwent multiple surgical resections due to recurrent disease.

pmc-13080169.title: Arthroscopic Microfracture for Focal Glenoid Osteochondral Lesions in Young Active-Duty Military Patients: A Minimum 10-Year Follow-Up
pmc-13080169.creator: Erel Ben-Ari, Clare K. Green, John P. Scanaliato, Alexis B. Sandler, Ron Gilat, John R. Tyler, Nata Parnes
pmc-13080169.description: Background:Glenoid osteochondral defects (OCDs), while uncommon, are a recognized source of shoulder pain and dysfunction, particularly in young, active individuals. Arthroscopic microfracture (MFx) is a commonly used surgical option. However, long-term outcomes remain poorly defined.Purpose:To evaluate long-term clinical and functional outcomes after arthroscopic MFx for focal glenoid OCD in active-duty military patients.Study Design:Case series; Level of evidence, 4.

pmc-13249700.title: Underrecognized depressive and anxiety symptoms in inflammatory arthritis: implications for systematic screening using PHQ-9 and GAD-7
pmc-13249700.creator: Monika Kolasińska, Mateusz Wilk, Dagna Polak, Marcin Siwek, Anna Julia Krupa, Mariusz Korkosz, Zofia Guła
pmc-13249700.description: Depression and anxiety are common comorbidities in patients with inflammatory arthritis (IA), including rheumatoid arthritis (RA), axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) and psoriatic arthritis (PsA). Despite their clinical relevance and impact on disease outcomes, these mental health conditions remain frequently underrecognized in routine rheumatology practice.

pmc-13322577.title: The Use of Metaverse in Fetal Cardiology
pmc-13322577.creator: Maria De Fátima Monteiro Pereira Leite, Nathalie Jeanne Bravo-Valenzuela, Edward Araujo Júnior, Heron Werner
pmc-13322577.description: d assessment of both normal fetal cardiac anatomy and congenital heart disease. Among these innovations, spatio-temporal image correlation (STIC) has become particularly valuable. STIC technology enables the acquisition of three-dimensional (3D) fetal cardiac volumes over multiple cardiac cycles, reconstructing a synchronized cine loop that facilitates consistent visualization even in cases of complex anomalies.

pmc-13379454.title: Olaparib alleviates diclofenac-induced toxicity in HepG2 cells via modulation of oxidative stress and mitochondrial functions
pmc-13379454.creator: Mohamed Maki, Viola B Vantus, Balazs Koszegi, Aliz Szabo, Katalin Fekete, Omeralfaroug Ali, Maysaa A Ali, Tibor Z Janosi, Ferenc Gallyas
pmc-13379454.description: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory agents are widely used for their analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, and a prominent representative of the drug family, diclofenac has recently been proposed for cancer therapy. However, overdose of diclofenac has also been reported to cause liver toxicity, whereas olaparib, a widely used antineoplastic poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase inhibitor, is known for its mitochondria-mediated cytoprotective properties.

pmc-13655419.title: Position-specific differences in match performance of elite U-17 soccer players using GPS-derived external load data: focus on forwards and defenders
pmc-13655419.creator: Chulsoon Choi, Hoseong Lee, Kwangjin Lee
pmc-13655419.description: [Purpose] The objective of this study was to investigate differences in match performance characteristics between forwards and defenders among elite U-17 soccer players using Global Positioning System (GPS)-derived data.[Methods] This study included 37 elite U-17 soccer players representing Gyeonggi Province. External load data collected during official matches were analyzed.

pmc-13668918.title: Development of a genetic transformation system in Echinochloa phyllopogon by particle bombardment
pmc-13668918.creator: Takahiro Gondo, Manami Sugahara, Hwan May Ng, Kentaro Yasuda, Satoshi Iwakami
pmc-13668918.description: Key MessageA stable particle bombardment-mediated transformation system was developed for Echinochloa phyllopogon, providing a platform for functional analysis of genes involved in herbicide metabolic detoxification.AbstractEchinochloa phyllopogon is a major C4 grass weed that causes serious yield losses in paddy fields and has evolved resistance to multiple herbicides.
